text:
sara: Quick sync — need to align scope for JSON-mode launch (hosted API). Customers are asking for strict JSON Schema validation + retry hooks. Proposed P0: JSON Schema v7 support, single-schema enforcement, clear error codes, and a retry_hint in the response. P1: partial-mode, auto-fix suggestions, and $ref/remote schemas. Thoughts?

Derek: +1 to v7. Concern: strict validation will cause a lot of user breakage unless we provide a safe fallback. Suggest we expose validation_level: "strict" | "best_effort" | "auto" and default to best_effort for existing customers. :thinking:

maria: From support calls — customers want deterministic failures (so automated systems can react) and a concise error structure to tie to metrics. They also want a retry hook so UI can surface an edit flow. They use tool-calling widely, so output shape must remain compatible with function schemas.

kevin: A few implementation notes: the runtime streams tokens — full validation happens post-generation which adds latency. Options: 1) post-validate + retry with low-temp deterministic pass, 2) generator-aware constraints (token-level guidance) but that's brittle. My quick idea: streaming unchanged, on final parse fail trigger deterministic retry (temperature=0, top_p small) and return either success or structured validation error. We'll need a validation queue and small worker pool.

ashley: Launch criteria proposal: P0 must include API param json_schema and validation_policy with admitted values {strict, best_effort, retry_once}. SDK helpers that parse errors and produce retry prompts. Docs + examples for common failure modes. P1: support for $ref and remote schemas, contextual schema arrays, and tooling to diff schema regressions.

policy-bot: Note: remote $ref fetching is a security vector. Default behavior should be to disallow network fetches; add opt-in with org-level allowlist and KMS audit.

Derek: Edge cases — multi-object arrays, trailing commas, dangling commas mid-stream. We should define an explicit repair mode that tries a deterministic sanitizer before failing; however, be explicit in docs about hallucinated "fixes" and provide a confidence score.

maria: Customer feature ask I heard: a webhook for validation_failures with fields {request_id, error_code, schema_path, example_snippet} so product owners can triage. Add to roadmap.

sara: OK next steps: I'll open the API spec PR with fields, error code taxonomy, retry_policy matrix, and perf targets (goal: validation overhead < 200ms p50 on 1k-token outputs for strict mode using our worker pool). @kevin can you estimate dev effort and infra needs? @ashley please add these to the product board and mark customers for beta.

kevin: Rough estimate: eng core + runtime changes 3 sprints, infra + validation workers 1 sprint, docs/SDK 1 sprint. Risk areas: cache invalidation for KV prefix caching if we change deterministic seeds for retry and complexity in multi-tenant worker throttles. Will follow up in a more detailed breakdown.

ashley: :thumbsup: Adding to roadmap, will propose a small beta with 3 customers who requested strict validation. Also adding a short rollout plan: canary -> beta -> GA with rollback policy to best_effort.

policy-bot: Security checklist: remote schema fetches disabled by default, audit logs for retry events, SRE validation for worker autoscaling.

sara: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the PR and share a checklist.

kevin: Quick example API usage to include in the PR (draft):
```json
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-xxl",
  "input": "...",
  "json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name"]},
  "validation_policy": "retry_once"
}
```

maria: Will add a support playbook for common error codes.

sara: great, will tag you all on the PR. thx!
